````cpp
#include "n8/desktop/N8Rpc.hpp"

#include <cstddef>
#include <exception>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string_view>
#include <system_error>
#include <utility>

#include "n8/Menu.hpp"
#include "n8/Ops.hpp"
#include "n8/desktop/PortTransport.hpp"

namespace rp::n8 {

// One open session: its port, and the Edio over it. Declared here, so the facet's header names no transport.
struct N8Rpc::Session {
    Session(std::string name, std::unique_ptr<retroplug::PortTransport> p)
        : portName(std::move(name)), port(std::move(p)), edio(*port) {}

    std::string                               portName;
    std::unique_ptr<retroplug::PortTransport> port;  // before edio, which holds a reference to it
    Edio                                      edio;
};

namespace {

// A reply from a status: its code and step by name, the N8's own byte when it answered one, and the failure's text as
// the CLI prints it (the port's own words when the port failed, else describe()'s, given the call's path). A call the
// port itself failed (deps/serial threw, and the transport answered short) is "linkDown" whatever Edio made of the
// short answer: Edio sees a read that brought nothing, which on a port that cannot tell its link's state is a
// timeout, but the port is gone, not slow, and the TS client throws an N8TimeoutError only for a "timeout".
N8Reply replyOf(const Status& status, const retroplug::PortTransport& port, std::string_view path = {}) {
    N8Reply r;
    r.status = status.ok() || port.failure().empty() ? codeName(status.code) : codeName(Code::LinkDown);
    r.step   = stepName(status.step);
    if (status.code == Code::Device) r.deviceStatus = status.device;
    if (!status.ok()) r.message = retroplug::failureText(status, port, path);
    return r;
}

N8Reply notOpen(std::int32_t handle) {
    N8Reply r;
    r.status  = codeName(Code::LinkDown);
    r.message = "no open N8 session (handle " + std::to_string(handle) + ")";
    return r;
}

// A listing's name as the TS client decoded it (TextDecoder, the WHATWG UTF-8 decoder): every well-formed sequence
// kept, and each maximal ill-formed subpart replaced by U+FFFD, so a card's non-UTF-8 name reaches JS as it always did
// and never as whatever a codec makes of invalid UTF-8.
std::string wellFormed(std::string_view raw) {
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(raw.size());
    std::size_t i = 0;
    while (i < raw.size()) {
        const auto  lead   = static_cast<unsigned char>(raw[i]);
        std::size_t needed = 0;
        unsigned    lower = 0x80, upper = 0xBF;
        if (lead <= 0x7F) {
            out.push_back(static_cast<char>(lead));
            ++i;
            continue;
        }
        if (lead >= 0xC2 && lead <= 0xDF) needed = 1;
        else if (lead >= 0xE0 && lead <= 0xEF) {
            needed = 2;
            if (lead == 0xE0) lower = 0xA0;
            if (lead == 0xED) upper = 0x9F;
        } else if (lead >= 0xF0 && lead <= 0xF4) {
            needed = 3;
            if (lead == 0xF0) lower = 0x90;
            if (lead == 0xF4) upper = 0x8F;
        }
        std::size_t seen = 0;
        while (needed != 0 && seen < needed && i + 1 + seen < raw.size()) {
            const auto b = static_cast<unsigned char>(raw[i + 1 + seen]);
            if (b < lower || b > upper) break;
            lower = 0x80;
            upper = 0xBF;
            ++seen;
        }
        if (needed != 0 && seen == needed) out.append(raw.substr(i, needed + 1));
        else out.append("\xEF\xBF\xBD");  // U+FFFD for the lead and the continuations it took
        i += 1 + seen;
    }
    return out;
}

// Whether two port names are one device: the same name, or (where the platform resolves them: a /dev/serial/by-id
// symlink and the /dev/ttyACM it points at) the same file. The port lister names ports only, so this is the identity
// it allows.
bool samePort(const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
    if (a == b) return true;
    if (a.empty() || b.empty()) return false;
    std::error_code ea, eb;
    const auto      ca = std::filesystem::canonical(a, ea);
    const auto      cb = std::filesystem::canonical(b, eb);
    return !ea && !eb && ca == cb;
}

rfl::Bytestring bytesOf(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size) {
    const auto* b = reinterpret_cast<const std::byte*>(data);
    return rfl::Bytestring(b, b + size);
}

const std::uint8_t* dataOf(const rfl::Bytestring& bytes) { return reinterpret_cast<const std::uint8_t*>(bytes.data()); }

}  // namespace

N8Rpc::N8Rpc(retroplug::N8Host& host, retroplug::N8Link::PortFactory factory, retroplug::N8Host::PortLister lister)
    : host_(host), factory_(std::move(factory)), lister_(std::move(lister)) {
    host_.setPortGuard([this](const std::string& port) {
        for (const auto& [handle, session] : sessions_)
            if (samePort(session->portName, port)) return "the port " + port + " is open in an N8 session";
        return std::string();
    });
}

N8Rpc::~N8Rpc() { host_.setPortGuard(nullptr); }

N8Rpc::Session* N8Rpc::find(std::int32_t handle) {
    const auto it = sessions_.find(handle);
    return it == sessions_.end() ? nullptr : it->second.get();
}

std::vector<retroplug::N8PortDto> N8Rpc::n8ListPorts() {
    return lister_ ? lister_() : std::vector<retroplug::N8PortDto>{};
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8Open(std::string port) {
    N8Reply r;
    r.status  = codeName(Code::LinkDown);
    r.message = "cannot open serial port: " + port;
    // The streaming link's port is not a session's, as it is not another process's: two writers on one N8 would
    // interleave their commands.
    if ((host_.link().isConnected() || host_.cartJobBusy()) && samePort(host_.link().portName(), port)) return r;
    std::unique_ptr<retroplug::PortTransport> transport;
    try {
        transport = factory_ ? factory_(port) : nullptr;
    } catch (const std::exception&) {
        return r;  // absent, busy, no permission
    }
    if (!transport) return r;
    const std::int32_t handle = nextHandle_++;
    sessions_.emplace(handle, std::make_unique<Session>(port, std::move(transport)));
    r         = N8Reply{};
    r.value   = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(handle);
    return r;
}

bool N8Rpc::n8Close(std::int32_t handle) { return sessions_.erase(handle) > 0; }

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8Handshake(std::int32_t handle, std::uint32_t timeoutMs) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    if (!s) return notOpen(handle);
    std::uint8_t code = 0;
    N8Reply      r    = replyOf(s->edio.connect(&code, timeoutMs), *s->port);
    r.value           = code;
    return r;
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8Status(std::int32_t handle) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    if (!s) return notOpen(handle);
    std::uint8_t code = 0;
    N8Reply      r    = replyOf(s->edio.status(code), *s->port);
    r.value           = code;
    return r;
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8SysInfo(std::int32_t handle) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    if (!s) return notOpen(handle);
    std::uint8_t info[Edio::SIZE_SYS_INFO];
    const Status st = s->edio.sysInfo(info);
    N8Reply      r  = replyOf(st, *s->port);
    if (st.ok()) r.bytes = bytesOf(info, sizeof info);
    return r;
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8Vdc(std::int32_t handle) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    if (!s) return notOpen(handle);
    std::uint8_t vdc[Edio::SIZE_VDC];
    const Status st = s->edio.vdc(vdc);
    N8Reply      r  = replyOf(st, *s->port);
    if (st.ok()) r.bytes = bytesOf(vdc, sizeof vdc);
    return r;
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8FreeSpace(std::int32_t handle) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    if (!s) return notOpen(handle);
    std::uint64_t free = 0;
    N8Reply       r    = replyOf(s->edio.freeSpace(free), *s->port);
    r.value            = free;
    return r;
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8DirMake(std::int32_t handle, std::string path) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    return s ? replyOf(s->edio.dirMake(path), *s->port, path) : notOpen(handle);
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8FileDelete(std::int32_t handle, std::string path) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    return s ? replyOf(s->edio.fileDelete(path), *s->port, path) : notOpen(handle);
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8MemRD(std::int32_t handle, std::uint32_t addr, std::uint32_t size) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    if (!s) return notOpen(handle);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> buf(size);
    const Status              st = s->edio.memRD(addr, buf.data(), buf.size());
    N8Reply                   r  = replyOf(st, *s->port);
    if (st.ok()) r.bytes = bytesOf(buf.data(), buf.size());
    return r;
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8MemWR(std::int32_t handle, std::uint32_t addr, rfl::Bytestring data) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    return s ? replyOf(s->edio.memWR(addr, dataOf(data), data.size()), *s->port) : notOpen(handle);
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8FifoWR(std::int32_t handle, rfl::Bytestring data) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    return s ? replyOf(s->edio.fifoWR(dataOf(data), data.size()), *s->port) : notOpen(handle);
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8FifoTxString(std::int32_t handle, std::string text) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    return s ? replyOf(s->edio.fifoTxString(text), *s->port, text) : notOpen(handle);
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8ListDir(std::int32_t handle, std::string path) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    if (!s) return notOpen(handle);
    std::vector<N8DirEntryDto> entries;
    const Status               st = s->edio.listDir(path, [&](const DirEntry& e) {
        entries.push_back({wellFormed(e.name), e.size, e.isDir});
    });
    N8Reply r = replyOf(st, *s->port, path);
    if (st.ok()) r.entries = std::move(entries);
    return r;
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8FileOpen(std::int32_t handle, std::string path, std::int32_t mode) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    return s ? replyOf(s->edio.fileOpen(path, static_cast<std::uint8_t>(mode)), *s->port, path) : notOpen(handle);
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8FileRead(std::int32_t handle, std::uint32_t size) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    if (!s) return notOpen(handle);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> buf(size);
    const Status              st = s->edio.fileRead(buf.data(), buf.size());
    N8Reply                   r  = replyOf(st, *s->port);
    if (st.ok()) r.bytes = bytesOf(buf.data(), buf.size());
    return r;
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8FileWrite(std::int32_t handle, rfl::Bytestring data) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    return s ? replyOf(s->edio.fileWrite(dataOf(data), data.size()), *s->port) : notOpen(handle);
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8FileClose(std::int32_t handle) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    return s ? replyOf(s->edio.fileClose(), *s->port) : notOpen(handle);
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8ReadData(std::int32_t handle, std::uint32_t size, std::uint32_t timeoutMs) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    if (!s) return notOpen(handle);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> buf(size);
    const Status              st = s->edio.readData(buf.data(), buf.size(), timeoutMs);
    N8Reply                   r  = replyOf(st, *s->port);
    if (st.ok()) r.bytes = bytesOf(buf.data(), buf.size());
    return r;
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8FlushInput(std::int32_t handle) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    if (!s) return notOpen(handle);
    s->edio.flushInput();
    return N8Reply{};
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8SetReadTimeout(std::int32_t handle, std::uint32_t ms) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    if (!s) return notOpen(handle);
    s->edio.timeouts().readMs = ms;
    return N8Reply{};
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8MenuTest(std::int32_t handle) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    return s ? replyOf(Menu(s->edio).test(), *s->port) : notOpen(handle);
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8MenuInstall(std::int32_t handle, std::string path) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    if (!s) return notOpen(handle);
    std::uint16_t index = 0;
    N8Reply       r     = replyOf(Menu(s->edio).install(path, &index), *s->port, path);
    r.value             = index;
    return r;
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8MenuStart(std::int32_t handle) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    return s ? replyOf(Menu(s->edio).start(), *s->port) : notOpen(handle);
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8MenuVramDump(std::int32_t handle) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    if (!s) return notOpen(handle);
    std::uint8_t vram[Menu::kVramBytes];
    std::uint8_t palette[Menu::kPaletteBytes];
    const Status st = Menu(s->edio).vramDump(vram, palette);
    N8Reply      r  = replyOf(st, *s->port);
    if (st.ok()) {
        r.bytes = bytesOf(vram, sizeof vram);
        const rfl::Bytestring tail = bytesOf(palette, sizeof palette);
        r.bytes.insert(r.bytes.end(), tail.begin(), tail.end());
    }
    return r;
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8MenuReset(std::int32_t handle) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    return s ? replyOf(Menu(s->edio).reset(), *s->port) : notOpen(handle);
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8ReadFile(std::int32_t handle, std::string path) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    if (!s) return notOpen(handle);
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> buf;
    const FileSink            sink{[](void* ctx, std::size_t size) {
                            auto& b = *static_cast<std::vector<std::uint8_t>*>(ctx);
                            b.resize(size);
                            return b.data();
                        },
                        &buf};
    std::size_t  size = 0;
    const Status st   = readFile(s->edio, path, sink, &size);
    N8Reply      r    = replyOf(st, *s->port, path);
    if (st.ok()) r.bytes = bytesOf(buf.data(), size);
    return r;
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8WriteFile(std::int32_t handle, std::string path, rfl::Bytestring data) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    return s ? replyOf(writeFile(s->edio, path, ByteView{dataOf(data), data.size()}), *s->port, path) : notOpen(handle);
}

N8Reply N8Rpc::n8BootRom(std::int32_t handle, std::string path, rfl::Bytestring rom, rfl::Bytestring srm,
                         bool upload) {
    Session* s = find(handle);
    if (!s) return notOpen(handle);
    std::uint16_t index = 0;
    const Status  st    = bootRom(s->edio, path, ByteView{dataOf(rom), rom.size()}, ByteView{dataOf(srm), srm.size()},
                                  upload ? Upload::Always : Upload::Never, &index);
    N8Reply       r     = replyOf(st, *s->port, path);
    r.value             = index;
    return r;
}

}  // namespace rp::n8
````

````diff
+// The most of a device's fail() reason a record keeps (rp_jobs.h): a bound, so a device's runaway text does not reach
+// the RPC whole, far past any reason a device writes.
+inline constexpr std::size_t kFailReasonBytes = 1024;
+
+// A device's fail() reason as a record keeps it: at most kFailReasonBytes, cut back to the start of the code point the
+// bound would split (the reason crosses the RPC as a string), as a submit's refusal is (rp_job_error, the engine's
+// deviceReason).
+inline std::string failReason(const char* reason) {
+    if (reason == nullptr) return {};
+    std::size_t n = 0;
+    while (n < kFailReasonBytes && reason[n] != '\0') ++n;
+    if (n == kFailReasonBytes && reason[n] != '\0') {
+        // Cut: back over the continuation bytes at the end of what is kept, and drop the sequence they belong to when
+        // the cut leaves it incomplete.
+        std::size_t lead = n;
+        while (lead > 0 && n - lead < 3 && (static_cast<unsigned char>(reason[lead - 1]) & 0xC0u) == 0x80u) --lead;
+        if (lead > 0) {
+            const auto        b    = static_cast<unsigned char>(reason[lead - 1]);
+            const std::size_t want = (b & 0xE0u) == 0xC0u ? 2 : (b & 0xF0u) == 0xE0u ? 3 : (b & 0xF8u) == 0xF0u ? 4 : 1;
+            if (want > 1 && n - (lead - 1) < want) n = lead - 1;
+        }
+    }
+    return std::string(reason, n);
+}
````

- [ ] **Step 6: The pack's tests**

`Edio.test.cpp`'s golden loop requires 28 cases and drives the new ones through `Edio::listDir`, `Ops::readFile`,
`Menu` and `Ops::bootRom` (an SD path means `Upload::Never`, otherwise the ROM goes to `usb-games/<romName>`, as
`n8Load.ts` did), with every queued reply read and the parsed values checked (the map index, the listing's entries);
it adds the cases the TS file had and the C++ lacked (every failure each primitive can meet, one write per frame,
`TooLarge`, the visitor over a long name, a link going down inside a wait, the timeouts). `Ops.test.cpp` replaces
`menu-load.test.ts`'s menu and boot cases. `QjsRpc.hpp` is a QuickJS-codec server for the tests, since the facet's
`rfl::Bytestring` does not compile under the JSON codec, so `[n8-rpc]` and `[providers]` move onto it; `[n8-rpc]`
gains the sessions, the gone port, the names and the port guard both ways. `FakeN8.hpp` is retyped onto
`PortTransport` and extended (system info, VDC, free space, mkdir, a listing of the directories made, delete status,
`*v`, `*r`, injected test and install replies, a write counter); the job, link and hwtest fakes no longer throw.

Create `packages/n8/native/test/Ops.test.cpp`:

````cpp
// Guards the on-device menu's commands (n8/Menu.hpp) and the operations over them (n8/Ops.hpp) against FakeN8.hpp's
// model of the cart, which answers the menu's '*' commands and keeps an SD card, a battery and the FPGA config block:
// the menu's replies and refusals (worded as the TS client threw them, which the CLI prints), a ROM booted through the
// menu with and without its upload and its battery, a cancel at each of bootRom's stop points and the step a failure
// names, a file read and written whole, the cart-SRAM paths the CLI's direct writes take, free space, mkdir and delete.
#include <catch2/catch_test_macros.hpp>

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "FakeN8.hpp"
#include "n8/Edio.hpp"
#include "n8/Menu.hpp"
#include "n8/Ops.hpp"

using retroplug::test::Bytes;
using retroplug::test::FakeN8;
using retroplug::test::FakeN8Port;
using rp::n8::Code;
using rp::n8::Edio;
using rp::n8::Menu;
using rp::n8::Status;
using rp::n8::Step;
using rp::n8::Where;

namespace {

std::string text(const Status& s, std::string_view path = {}) {
    char buf[512];
    rp::n8::describe(s, buf, sizeof buf, path);
    return buf;
}

// The FIFO writes the cart saw, in order ("fifo:2A 74" is '*t').
std::vector<std::string> fifoLog(FakeN8& dev) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(dev.mu);
    std::vector<std::string>    out;
    for (const std::string& e : dev.log)
        if (e.rfind("fifo:", 0) == 0) out.push_back(e);
    return out;
}

Bytes pattern(std::size_t n, std::uint8_t seed) {
    Bytes b(n);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) b[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(seed + i * 7);
    return b;
}

}  // namespace

// --- the menu's commands -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

TEST_CASE("the menu's test takes 'k', and anything else or nothing is a failure in the menu's words", "[n8][menu]") {
    FakeN8     dev;
    FakeN8Port port(dev);
    Edio       edio(port);
    CHECK(Menu(edio).test().ok());
    CHECK(fifoLog(dev) == std::vector<std::string>{"fifo:2A 74"});

    dev.testReply = 'x';
    const Status other = Menu(edio).test();
    CHECK(other.code == Code::BadReply);
    CHECK(other.where == Where::MenuTest);
    CHECK(text(other) == "N8 menu: unexpected test response 0x78 (is the menu running?)");

    dev.menu = false;  // a running game reads no '*' command and answers nothing
    const Status none = Menu(edio).test();
    CHECK(none.code == Code::Timeout);
    CHECK(text(none) == "Edio: serial read timeout (no N8 response)");
}

TEST_CASE("install sends '*n' and the path, answers the map index, and words the menu's refusals", "[n8][menu]") {
    FakeN8     dev;
    FakeN8Port port(dev);
    Edio       edio(port);
    dev.mapIndex        = 0x123;
    std::uint16_t index = 0;
    REQUIRE(Menu(edio).install("usb-games/x.nes", &index).ok());
    CHECK(index == 0x123);
    // '*n', then the path as fifoTxString sends one: its length, then its bytes, each a FIFO write of its own.
    CHECK(fifoLog(dev) == std::vector<std::string>{"fifo:2A 6E", "fifo:0F 00",
                                                   "fifo:75 73 62 2D 67 61 6D 65 73 2F 78 2E 6E 65 73"});

    dev.installStatus = 0x44;
    const Status heap = Menu(edio).install("usb-games/x.nes");
    CHECK(heap.code == Code::Device);
    CHECK(heap.device == 0x44);
    CHECK(text(heap, "usb-games/x.nes") ==
          "N8 menu out of memory (0x44) - the menu heap is dirty (e.g. after a prior failed load). Power-cycle the "
          "console to a fresh menu and retry.");

    dev.installStatus = 0x12;
    const Status refused = Menu(edio).install("usb-games/x.nes");
    CHECK(refused.where == Where::Install);
    CHECK(text(refused, "usb-games/x.nes") == "N8 menu: app install error 0x12 (path 'usb-games/x.nes')");
}

TEST_CASE("start boots what the menu installed; vramDump and reset", "[n8][menu]") {
    FakeN8     dev;
    FakeN8Port port(dev);
    Edio       edio(port);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < dev.vram.size(); ++i) dev.vram[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < dev.palette.size(); ++i) dev.palette[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(0xA0 + i);
    std::uint8_t vram[Menu::kVramBytes], palette[Menu::kPaletteBytes];
    REQUIRE(Menu(edio).vramDump(vram, palette).ok());
    CHECK(vram[300] == static_cast<std::uint8_t>(300));
    CHECK(palette[15] == 0xAF);

    REQUIRE(Menu(edio).reset().ok());  // no ack comes, which is fine
    CHECK(dev.resets == 1);

    REQUIRE(Menu(edio).install("usb-games/x.nes").ok());
    REQUIRE(Menu(edio).start().ok());
    CHECK(dev.booted == "usb-games/x.nes");
    CHECK_FALSE(dev.menu);
}

// --- a boot ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

TEST_CASE("bootRom tests the menu, uploads the ROM and its battery, installs and starts, in that order", "[n8][ops]") {
    FakeN8        dev;
    FakeN8Port    port(dev);
    Edio          edio(port);
    const Bytes   rom = pattern(3000, 1), srm = pattern(8192, 2);
    std::uint16_t index = 0;
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> done;
    std::uint32_t              total = 0;
    auto step = [&](std::uint32_t d, std::uint32_t t) {
        done.push_back(d);
        total = t;
        return true;
    };
    REQUIRE(rp::n8::bootRom(edio, "usb-games/song.nes", {rom.data(), rom.size()}, {srm.data(), srm.size()},
                            rp::n8::Upload::Always, &index, rp::n8::progressOf(step))
                .ok());
    CHECK(index == 69);
    CHECK(dev.files["usb-games/song.nes"] == rom);
    CHECK(dev.files["EDN8/gamedata/song.nes/bram.srm"] == srm);
    CHECK(dev.booted == "usb-games/song.nes");
    CHECK(dev.filesOpen == 0);
    // '*t' first and '*s' last, the files between them (each one write command, not one per block).
    const auto fifo = fifoLog(dev);
    REQUIRE(fifo.size() >= 3);
    CHECK(fifo.front() == "fifo:2A 74");
    CHECK(fifo.back() == "fifo:2A 73");
    CHECK(dev.count("file-wr") == 2);
    // The bytes, of both files, counted together and never backwards, ending at the whole.
    CHECK(total == rom.size() + srm.size());
    CHECK(done.front() == 0);
    CHECK(done.back() == total);
    for (std::size_t i = 1; i < done.size(); ++i) CHECK(done[i] >= done[i - 1]);
}

TEST_CASE("bootRom with no upload boots what the card holds, and an empty battery writes no slot", "[n8][ops]") {
    FakeN8     dev;
    FakeN8Port port(dev);
    Edio       edio(port);
    REQUIRE(rp::n8::bootRom(edio, "games/held.nes", {}, {}, rp::n8::Upload::Never, nullptr).ok());
    CHECK(dev.booted == "games/held.nes");
    CHECK(dev.count("file-wr") == 0);
    CHECK(dev.files.empty());
}

TEST_CASE("a cancel at each of bootRom's stop points stops it there, and the status names the step", "[n8][ops]") {
    // The calls a 1 KB ROM and a 1 KB battery make: before the test (a stop point), before the ROM's open (one), its
    // block (a report: the cart takes the command's payload whole), before the battery's open (one), its block (a
    // report), before the install (one). Cancelling from call k on stops at the first stop point at or after it.
    struct Expect {
        Step step;
        bool rom, srm;
    };
    const Expect expected[] = {
        {Step::Test, false, false}, {Step::Upload, false, false}, {Step::Save, true, false},
        {Step::Save, true, false},  {Step::Install, true, true},  {Step::Install, true, true},
    };
    const Bytes rom = pattern(1024, 3), srm = pattern(1024, 4);
    for (int k = 1; k <= 7; ++k) {
        INFO("cancel from call " << k);
        FakeN8     dev;
        FakeN8Port port(dev);
        Edio       edio(port);
        int        calls = 0;
        auto       step  = [&](std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t) { return ++calls < k; };
        const Status s = rp::n8::bootRom(edio, "usb-games/c.nes", {rom.data(), rom.size()},
                                         {srm.data(), srm.size()}, rp::n8::Upload::Always, nullptr,
                                         rp::n8::progressOf(step));
        if (k == 7) {
            CHECK(s.ok());
            CHECK(dev.booted == "usb-games/c.nes");
            continue;
        }
        const Expect& e = expected[k - 1];
        CHECK(s.code == Code::Cancelled);
        CHECK(s.step == e.step);
        CHECK(dev.files.count("usb-games/c.nes") == (e.rom ? 1u : 0u));
        CHECK(dev.files.count("EDN8/gamedata/c.nes/bram.srm") == (e.srm ? 1u : 0u));
        CHECK(dev.booted.empty());
        CHECK(dev.filesOpen == 0);  // a cancel comes between commands: nothing is left open
        CHECK(fifoLog(dev).size() == (e.step == Step::Test ? 0u : 1u));  // '*t' at most: no install, no start
    }
}

TEST_CASE("bootRom names the step that failed, so a caller keeps its policy around it", "[n8][ops]") {
    const Bytes rom = pattern(100, 5);
    {
        FakeN8 dev;
        dev.menu = false;  // a running game: '*t' goes unanswered
        FakeN8Port   port(dev);
        Edio         edio(port);
        const Status s =
            rp::n8::bootRom(edio, "usb-games/g.nes", {rom.data(), rom.size()}, {}, rp::n8::Upload::Always, nullptr);
        CHECK(s.code == Code::Timeout);
        CHECK(s.step == Step::Test);
        CHECK(dev.files.empty());  // nothing reached the card
    }
    {
        FakeN8 dev;
        dev.installStatus = 0x44;  // the box re-uploads and retries once on this
        FakeN8Port   port(dev);
        Edio         edio(port);
        const Status s =
            rp::n8::bootRom(edio, "usb-games/g.nes", {rom.data(), rom.size()}, {}, rp::n8::Upload::Always, nullptr);
        CHECK(s.code == Code::Device);
        CHECK(s.step == Step::Install);
        CHECK(s.device == 0x44);
        CHECK(dev.files["usb-games/g.nes"] == rom);
        CHECK(dev.booted.empty());
    }
    {
        FakeN8 dev;
        dev.failNextWrite = true;  // the upload's first block refused
        FakeN8Port   port(dev);
        Edio         edio(port);
        const Status s =
            rp::n8::bootRom(edio, "usb-games/g.nes", {rom.data(), rom.size()}, {}, rp::n8::Upload::Always, nullptr);
        CHECK(s.code == Code::Device);
        CHECK(s.where == Where::WriteAck);
        CHECK(s.step == Step::Upload);
        CHECK(text(s) == "Edio: tx ack error 0x01");
    }
}

// --- files -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

TEST_CASE("writeFile and readFile round-trip a file; NotFound, TooLarge with the size, and a cancel that closes",
          "[n8][ops]") {
    FakeN8      dev;
    FakeN8Port  port(dev);
    Edio        edio(port);
    const Bytes data = pattern(1300, 6);
    REQUIRE(rp::n8::writeFile(edio, "d/f.bin", {data.data(), data.size()}).ok());
    CHECK(dev.files["d/f.bin"] == data);

    Bytes       buf(4096);
    std::size_t size = 0;
    REQUIRE(rp::n8::readFile(edio, "d/f.bin", buf.data(), buf.size(), &size).ok());
    CHECK(size == data.size());
    CHECK(Bytes(buf.begin(), buf.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(size)) == data);
    CHECK(dev.count("file-rd") == 3);  // 512, 512, 276: one CMD_F_FRD a block
    CHECK(dev.filesOpen == 0);

    const Status missing = rp::n8::readFile(edio, "d/none.bin", buf.data(), buf.size(), &size);
    CHECK(missing.code == Code::NotFound);
    CHECK(text(missing, "d/none.bin") == "Edio: file not found on SD: d/none.bin");

    const Status small = rp::n8::readFile(edio, "d/f.bin", buf.data(), 100, &size);
    CHECK(small.code == Code::TooLarge);
    CHECK(size == data.size());  // what a caller needs to know to try again
    CHECK(dev.filesOpen == 0);   // nothing was opened

    int  blocks = 0;
    auto step   = [&](std::uint32_t done, std::uint32_t) { return done == 0 || ++blocks < 1; };
    const Status cancelled =
        rp::n8::readFile(edio, "d/f.bin", buf.data(), buf.size(), &size, rp::n8::progressOf(step));
    CHECK(cancelled.code == Code::Cancelled);
    CHECK(cancelled.step == Step::Data);
    CHECK(dev.filesOpen == 0);  // the cancel came between two blocks, and closed the file
}

TEST_CASE("the cart-SRAM paths: a battery written straight to SRAM reads back, and a dump reads all of it",
          "[n8][ops]") {
    FakeN8      dev;
    FakeN8Port  port(dev);
    Edio        edio(port);
    const Bytes save = pattern(8192, 7);
    REQUIRE(edio.memWR(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(Edio::ADDR_SRM), save.data(), save.size()).ok());
    Bytes back(save.size());
    REQUIRE(edio.memRD(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(Edio::ADDR_SRM), back.data(), back.size()).ok());
    CHECK(back == save);
    Bytes whole(Edio::SIZE_SRM_GAME);
    REQUIRE(edio.memRD(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(Edio::ADDR_SRM), whole.data(), whole.size()).ok());
    CHECK(Bytes(whole.begin(), whole.begin() + 8192) == save);
    CHECK(dev.count("srm-wr") == 1);
    CHECK(dev.count("srm-rd") == 2);
}

TEST_CASE("free space, mkdir (an existing directory included) and delete over the cart", "[n8][ops]") {
    FakeN8     dev;
    FakeN8Port port(dev);
    Edio       edio(port);
    dev.freeBytes       = (std::uint64_t{3} << 32) + 5;
    std::uint64_t bytes = 0;
    REQUIRE(edio.freeSpace(bytes).ok());
    CHECK(bytes == (std::uint64_t{3} << 32) + 5);

    REQUIRE(edio.dirMake("songs").ok());
    REQUIRE(edio.dirMake("songs").ok());  // "exists" is done
    REQUIRE(edio.dirMake("songs/new").ok());
    std::vector<std::string> dirs;
    REQUIRE(edio.listDir("songs", [&](const rp::n8::DirEntry& e) {
                    if (e.isDir) dirs.push_back(std::string(e.name));
                }).ok());
    CHECK(dirs == std::vector<std::string>{"new"});

    const Bytes one = {1};
    REQUIRE(rp::n8::writeFile(edio, "songs/a.sav", {one.data(), one.size()}).ok());
    REQUIRE(edio.fileDelete("songs/a.sav").ok());
    CHECK(dev.files.count("songs/a.sav") == 0);
    const Status gone = edio.fileDelete("songs/a.sav");
    CHECK(gone.code == Code::Device);
    CHECK(gone.device == 0x04);  // FatFs FR_NO_FILE
    CHECK(text(gone) == "Edio: operation error 0x04");
}
````

````cpp
#pragma once

// A server of the products' own type for the tests that mount the N8 facet: rpcpp's TypedRpcServer over the QuickJS
// codec, in a bare QuickJS context of its own. The facet's byte-carrying methods take and answer rfl::Bytestring,
// which the QuickJS codec carries as a Uint8Array and the JSON codec cannot carry at all, so a facet a JSON server
// could mount would be one no product mounts. ask() builds a request in JS from a params expression and answers the
// reply as JSON text, a Uint8Array in it written as the array of its bytes.
//
// Shared by retroplug-n8-test (N8Provider.test.cpp) and retroplug-engine-graph-test (Providers.test.cpp).

#include <string>

#include <quickjs.h>

#include "TypedRpcServer.h"
#include "codecs/QuickJSCodec.h"
#include "transports/QuickJSTransport.h"

namespace rp::n8::test {

class QjsRpc {
public:
    using Server = rpcpp::TypedRpcServer<rpcpp::Empty, rpcpp::QuickJSCodec>;

    QjsRpc() : transport_(js_.ctx, [](JSContext*, JSValue) {}), server_(transport_, rpcpp::QuickJSCodec{js_.ctx}) {}

    Server& server() { return server_; }

    // `method` called with `params`, a JS expression for its params array ("[]", `[0, new Uint8Array([1, 2])]`): the
    // reply (result or error) as JSON, or "" for none.
    std::string ask(const std::string& method, const std::string& params = "[]") {
        const std::string source = "({jsonrpc: \"2.0\", id: 1, method: \"" + method + "\", params: " + params + "})";
        JSValue           req    = JS_Eval(js_.ctx, source.c_str(), source.size(), "<ask>", JS_EVAL_TYPE_GLOBAL);
        auto              out    = server_.processMessage(req);
        JS_FreeValue(js_.ctx, req);
        if (!out) return {};
        JSValue reply = out->materialize(js_.ctx);
        JSValue show  = JS_Eval(js_.ctx, kShow, sizeof kShow - 1, "<show>", JS_EVAL_TYPE_GLOBAL);
        JSValue text  = JS_Call(js_.ctx, show, JS_UNDEFINED, 1, &reply);
        std::string result;
        if (const char* s = JS_ToCString(js_.ctx, text)) {
            result = s;
            JS_FreeCString(js_.ctx, s);
        }
        JS_FreeValue(js_.ctx, text);
        JS_FreeValue(js_.ctx, show);
        JS_FreeValue(js_.ctx, reply);
        return result;
    }

private:
    static constexpr char kShow[] =
        "(v) => JSON.stringify(v, (k, x) => (x instanceof Uint8Array ? Array.from(x) : typeof x === 'bigint' ? "
        "Number(x) : x))";

    // The runtime and its context, first in the object so they go last, after the server and the transport.
    struct Js {
        Js() : rt(JS_NewRuntime()), ctx(JS_NewContext(rt)) {}
        ~Js() {
            JS_FreeContext(ctx);
            JS_FreeRuntime(rt);
        }
        JSRuntime* rt;
        JSContext* ctx;
    };

    Js                      js_;
    rpcpp::QuickJSTransport transport_;
    Server                  server_;
};

}  // namespace rp::n8::test
````

````diff
+// An in-memory transport: writes append to `written` (each call counted); reads pop from a scripted `toRead` queue (an
+// empty queue answers 0 bytes, which Edio takes for a timeout); each read's timeout is recorded. `takeWrites` writes
+// are taken whole and every one after takes nothing, as a port that stopped taking bytes; `up` is linkUp(), and
+// `downAfterReads` reads take the link down once that many have been served.
+struct FakeSerialPort : PortTransport {
+    std::vector<std::uint8_t>  written;
+    std::vector<std::size_t>   writeSizes;
+    std::deque<std::uint8_t>   toRead;
+    std::vector<std::uint32_t> timeouts;
+    bool                       flushed        = false;
+    bool                       up             = true;
+    int                        takeWrites     = 1'000'000;
+    int                        downAfterReads = -1;
 
     std::size_t write(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size) override {
+        if (takeWrites <= 0) return 0;
+        --takeWrites;
         written.insert(written.end(), data, data + size);
+        writeSizes.push_back(size);
         return size;
     }
-    std::size_t read(std::uint8_t* buffer, std::size_t size, int /*timeoutMs*/) override {
+    std::size_t read(std::uint8_t* buffer, std::size_t size, std::uint32_t timeoutMs) override {
+        timeouts.push_back(timeoutMs);
         std::size_t n = 0;
         while (n < size && !toRead.empty()) {
             buffer[n++] = toRead.front();
             toRead.pop_front();
         }
+        if (downAfterReads > 0 && --downAfterReads == 0) up = false;
         return n;  // 0 => timeout
     }
     void flushInput() override { flushed = true; }
+    bool linkUp() const override { return up; }
 
     // Queue a little-endian 16-bit status word (what the N8 returns for CMD_STATUS).
     void queueStatus(std::uint16_t v) {
         toRead.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v & 0xFF));
         toRead.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v >> 8));
     }
+    void queue(std::initializer_list<std::uint8_t> bytes) { toRead.insert(toRead.end(), bytes); }
 };

+TEST_CASE("a status word that is not <status> A5 is BadReply wherever a status is read", "[n8][edio-status]") {

+        {"dirMake", [](Edio& e) { return e.dirMake("d"); }},
+        {"fileDelete", [](Edio& e) { return e.fileDelete("d"); }},
+        {"listDir", [](Edio& e) { return e.listDir("d", [](const rp::n8::DirEntry&) {}); }},
+        {"fileOpen", [](Edio& e) { return e.fileOpen("f", Edio::FA_READ); }},
+        {"fileClose", [](Edio& e) { return e.fileClose(); }},
+        {"fileWrite", [&](Edio& e) { return e.fileWrite(two, 2); }},  // its trailing status, after the block's ack

+TEST_CASE("a non-zero device status is Device, worded as the TS client threw it", "[n8][edio-status]") {

+         "Edio: operation error 0x04"},
+        {"fileClose", [](Edio& e) { return e.fileClose(); }, {0x01, 0xA5}, Where::Operation,
+         "Edio: operation error 0x01"},
+        {"listDir (load)", [](Edio& e) { return e.listDir("d", [](const rp::n8::DirEntry&) {}); }, {0x05, 0xA5},
+         Where::Operation, "Edio: operation error 0x05"},
+        {"listDir (entry)", [](Edio& e) { return e.listDir("d", [](const rp::n8::DirEntry&) {}); },
+         {0x00, 0xA5, 0x01, 0x00, 0x0B}, Where::DirEntry, "Edio: dir read error 0x0b"},
+        {"dirMake", [](Edio& e) { return e.dirMake("d"); }, {0x07, 0xA5}, Where::MkDir, "Edio: mkdir error 0x07 (d)"},
+        {"fileRead", [&](Edio& e) { return e.fileRead(buf, 2); }, {0x0C}, Where::FileBlock,

+        {"fileWrite (ack)", [&](Edio& e) { return e.fileWrite(two, 2); }, {0x0D}, Where::WriteAck,
+         "Edio: tx ack error 0x0d"},
+        {"fileWrite (status)", [&](Edio& e) { return e.fileWrite(two, 2); }, {0x00, 0x11, 0xA5}, Where::Operation,
+         "Edio: operation error 0x11"},

+TEST_CASE("one write per frame: a command, its arguments and its payload's first bytes go out in one write",
+          "[n8][edio-frame]") {
+    FakeSerialPort port;
+    Edio           edio(port);
+    const std::uint8_t note[3] = {0x90, 0x3C, 0x7F};
+    REQUIRE(edio.fifoWR(note, sizeof note).ok());
+    CHECK(port.writeSizes == std::vector<std::size_t>{16});  // 13 bytes of command, the 3 of the note
+
+    // A payload past the 256-byte frame: the frame full, then the rest in a write of its own.
+    port.writeSizes.clear();
+    std::vector<std::uint8_t> big(1000, 0x55);
+    REQUIRE(edio.memWR(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(Edio::ADDR_PRG), big.data(), big.size()).ok());
+    CHECK(port.writeSizes == std::vector<std::size_t>{256, 1013 - 256});
+
+    // And past 8 KB, in 8 KB writes after the frame, as the clients this replaced chunked it.
+    port.writeSizes.clear();
+    std::vector<std::uint8_t> huge(20000, 0x66);
+    REQUIRE(edio.memWR(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(Edio::ADDR_PRG), huge.data(), huge.size()).ok());
+    CHECK(port.writeSizes == std::vector<std::size_t>{256, 8192, 8192, 20013 - 256 - 2 * 8192});
+
+    // A path is its command's payload: fileOpen's header, mode, length and path in one write, the status poll another.
+    port.writeSizes.clear();
+    port.queueStatus(0xA500);
+    REQUIRE(edio.fileOpen("usb-games/a.nes", Edio::FA_READ).ok());
+    CHECK(port.writeSizes == std::vector<std::size_t>{4 + 1 + 2 + 15, 4});
+
+    // A file write's blocks go out as they are released, one write a block.
+    port.writeSizes.clear();
+    port.queue({0x00, 0x00});
+    port.queueStatus(0xA500);
+    std::vector<std::uint8_t> file(1500, 0x77);
+    REQUIRE(edio.fileWrite(file.data(), file.size()).ok());
+    CHECK(port.writeSizes == std::vector<std::size_t>{8, 1024, 476, 4});
+}

+TEST_CASE("listDir hands its visitor each entry, a 255-byte name whole, and the count", "[n8][edio-frame]") {
+    FakeSerialPort    port;
+    const std::string longName(255, 'n');
+    port.queueStatus(0xA500);
+    port.queue({0x02, 0x00});  // two records
+    // A file of 0x01020304 bytes with the longest name, then a directory "d".
+    port.queue({0x00, 0x04, 0x03, 0x02, 0x01, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x20, 0xFF, 0x00});
+    for (char c : longName) port.toRead.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(c));
+    port.queue({0x00, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x10, 0x01, 0x00, 'd'});
+    struct Seen {
+        std::string   name;
+        std::uint32_t size;
+        bool          isDir;
+    };
+    std::vector<Seen> seen;
+    std::uint16_t     count = 0;
+    const auto visit = [&](const rp::n8::DirEntry& e) { seen.push_back({std::string(e.name), e.size, e.isDir}); };
+    REQUIRE(Edio(port).listDir("x", visit, &count).ok());
+    CHECK(count == 2);
+    REQUIRE(seen.size() == 2);
+    CHECK(seen[0].name == longName);
+    CHECK(seen[0].size == 0x01020304u);
+    CHECK_FALSE(seen[0].isDir);
+    CHECK(seen[1].name == "d");
+    CHECK(seen[1].isDir);
+    // The request asked for names of at most 255 bytes, and an empty directory answers no record pull.
+    CHECK(std::vector<std::uint8_t>(port.written.end() - 10, port.written.end()) ==
+          fromHex("2bd4c837" "0000" "0200" "ff00"));
+    FakeSerialPort empty;
+    empty.queueStatus(0xA500);
+    empty.queue({0x00, 0x00});
+    CHECK(Edio(empty).listDir("x", [&](const rp::n8::DirEntry&) { FAIL("no entry"); }).ok());
+    CHECK(empty.written == fromHex("2bd4c53a01010078" "2bd410ef" "2bd4c639"));
+}

+TEST_CASE("each wait asks the transport for its own timeout from the table, and a call may override it",
+          "[n8][edio-frame]") {
+    FakeSerialPort port;
+    Edio           edio(port);
+    port.queueStatus(0xA500);

+    port.queueStatus(0xA500);
+    std::uint8_t code = 0;
+    REQUIRE(edio.status(code).ok());
+    CHECK(port.timeouts.back() == 2000);  // a reply
+    port.queue({0x00, 0xAA, 0xBB});
+    std::uint8_t two[2];
+    REQUIRE(edio.fileRead(two, 2).ok());
+    CHECK(port.timeouts.back() == 5000);  // a file block: its status and its data
+    port.timeouts.clear();
+    port.queue({0x00});
+    port.queueStatus(0xA500);
+    REQUIRE(edio.fileWrite(two, 2).ok());
+    CHECK(port.timeouts == std::vector<std::uint32_t>{5000, 2000});  // the block's ack, then the command's status
+    port.queue({0x00, 0x01, 0x00});
+    std::uint16_t index = 0;
+    REQUIRE(rp::n8::Menu(edio).install("p", &index).ok());
+    CHECK(index == 1);
+    CHECK(port.timeouts[port.timeouts.size() - 2] == 12000);  // the install's status, then the map index at 2 s
+    CHECK(port.timeouts.back() == 2000);
+    port.queueStatus(0xA500);
+    REQUIRE(edio.connect(nullptr, 50).ok());
+    CHECK(port.timeouts.back() == 50);
+    edio.timeouts().readMs = 700;
+    port.queue({0x01});
+    std::uint8_t v = 0;
+    REQUIRE(edio.rx8(v).ok());
+    CHECK(port.timeouts.back() == 700);
+}

+    reply = server.ask("n8ListDir", R"([0, "songs"])");
+    CHECK(has(reply, R"("entries":[])"));
+    reply = server.ask("n8FileDelete", R"([0, "songs/none.sav"])");
+    CHECK(has(reply, R"("status":"device")"));
+    CHECK(has(reply, R"("deviceStatus":4)"));
+    CHECK(has(reply, R"("message":"Edio: operation error 0x04")"));
+    // Bytes cross as a Uint8Array each way, as the products' codec carries them.
+    CHECK(has(server.ask("n8WriteFile", R"([0, "songs/a.bin", new Uint8Array([1, 2, 250])])"), R"("status":"ok")"));
+    CHECK(has(server.ask("n8ReadFile", R"([0, "songs/a.bin"])"), R"("bytes":[1,2,250])"));
+    CHECK(has(server.ask("n8Close", "[0]"), R"("result":true)"));
+    CHECK(has(server.ask("n8Close", "[0]"), R"("result":false)"));
+
+    rp::n8::test::QjsRpc other;
+    rp::n8::registerRpc(other.server(), nullptr);
+    CHECK(has(other.ask("n8LinkConfig"), "-32601"));  // Method not found
+    CHECK(has(other.ask("n8Open", R"(["/dev/ttyACM0"])"), "-32601"));
+}
+
+namespace {
+rfl::Bytestring bytesOf(const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& v) {
+    const auto* b = reinterpret_cast<const std::byte*>(v.data());
+    return rfl::Bytestring(b, b + v.size());
+}
+std::vector<std::uint8_t> vec(const rfl::Bytestring& b) {
+    const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const std::uint8_t*>(b.data());
+    return std::vector<std::uint8_t>(p, p + b.size());
+}
+}  // namespace

+TEST_CASE("a session runs the primitives, the menu and the operations on its handle, each answered as a reply",
+          "[n8-rpc]") {
+    FakeN8        dev;
+    N8Host        host(factoryFor(dev), twoPorts(), cleanDir("rp-n8-rpc-test").string());
+    rp::n8::N8Rpc rpc(host, factoryFor(dev), twoPorts());
+    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < dev.sysInfo.size(); ++i) dev.sysInfo[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
+    dev.freeBytes = 123456789012ull;
+
+    const rp::n8::N8Reply opened = rpc.n8Open("/dev/ttyACM0");
+    REQUIRE(opened.status == "ok");
+    const auto h = static_cast<std::int32_t>(opened.value);
+    CHECK(rpc.n8Handshake(h, 0).status == "ok");
+    CHECK(vec(rpc.n8SysInfo(h).bytes) == dev.sysInfo);
+    CHECK(rpc.n8Vdc(h).bytes.size() == 8);
+    CHECK(rpc.n8FreeSpace(h).value == 123456789012ull);
+
+    // A file round trip, then a ROM booted with its battery.
+    const std::vector<std::uint8_t> data = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
+    CHECK(rpc.n8WriteFile(h, "d/x.bin", bytesOf(data)).status == "ok");
+    CHECK(vec(rpc.n8ReadFile(h, "d/x.bin").bytes) == data);
+    const rp::n8::N8Reply listed = rpc.n8ListDir(h, "d");
+    REQUIRE(listed.entries.size() == 1);
+    CHECK(listed.entries[0].name == "x.bin");
+    CHECK(listed.entries[0].size == 5);
+    const rp::n8::N8Reply missing = rpc.n8ReadFile(h, "d/y.bin");
+    CHECK(missing.status == "notFound");
+    CHECK(missing.step == "list");
+    CHECK(missing.message == "Edio: file not found on SD: d/y.bin");
+
+    CHECK(rpc.n8MenuTest(h).status == "ok");
+    const std::vector<std::uint8_t> rom(2000, 0x4E), srm(100, 0x53);
+    const rp::n8::N8Reply booted = rpc.n8BootRom(h, "usb-games/g.nes", bytesOf(rom), bytesOf(srm), true);
+    CHECK(booted.status == "ok");
+    CHECK(booted.value == 69);
+    CHECK(dev.booted == "usb-games/g.nes");
+    CHECK(dev.files["EDN8/gamedata/g.nes/bram.srm"] == srm);
+
+    // A running game: the menu's test goes unanswered, and the reply is the CLI's N8TimeoutError.
+    const rp::n8::N8Reply test = rpc.n8MenuTest(h);
+    CHECK(test.status == "timeout");
+    CHECK(test.message == "Edio: serial read timeout (no N8 response)");
+    // The cart's FPGA config block, which says what runs (mapConfig.ts decodes it).
+    const rp::n8::N8Reply cfg = rpc.n8MemRD(h, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rp::n8::Edio::ADDR_CFG), 16);
+    REQUIRE(cfg.bytes.size() == 16);
+    CHECK(vec(cfg.bytes)[0] == 69);
+    CHECK(rpc.n8FifoWR(h, bytesOf({0x90, 0x3C, 0x7F})).status == "ok");
+    CHECK(dev.count("fifo:90 3C 7F") == 1);
+
+    CHECK(rpc.n8Close(h));
+    const rp::n8::N8Reply closed = rpc.n8Status(h);
+    CHECK(closed.status == "linkDown");
+    CHECK(closed.message == "no open N8 session (handle 0)");
+}

+TEST_CASE("a session does not open the port the streaming link holds, nor one its factory cannot open", "[n8-rpc]") {

+    rp::n8::N8Rpc rpc(host, factoryFor(dev), twoPorts());
+    host.connect(true);  // auto-picks /dev/ttyACM0

+    host.connect(false);
+
+    rp::n8::N8Rpc refusing(host, [](const std::string&) -> std::unique_ptr<retroplug::PortTransport> {
+        throw std::runtime_error("no such port");
+    }, twoPorts());
+    const rp::n8::N8Reply absent = refusing.n8Open("/dev/ttyACM7");
+    CHECK(absent.status == "linkDown");
+    CHECK(absent.message == "cannot open serial port: /dev/ttyACM7");
 }

+TEST_CASE("one writer to an N8: the link does not connect to a session's port, by name or by the device it names",
+          "[n8-rpc]") {
+    FakeN8        dev;
+    N8Host        host(factoryFor(dev), twoPorts(), cleanDir("rp-n8-rpc-test").string());
+    auto          rpc = std::make_unique<rp::n8::N8Rpc>(host, factoryFor(dev), twoPorts());
+    const auto    opened = rpc->n8Open("/dev/ttyACM0");
+    REQUIRE(opened.status == "ok");
+    host.connect(true);  // auto-picks /dev/ttyACM0, which the session holds
+    N8ConfigDto c = host.getConfig();
+    CHECK_FALSE(c.connected);
+    CHECK(c.enabled);  // as a connect that failed leaves it
+    CHECK(c.error == "the port /dev/ttyACM0 is open in an N8 session");
+    CHECK(rpc->n8Close(static_cast<std::int32_t>(opened.value)));
+    host.connect(true);
+    CHECK(host.getConfig().connected);
+    host.connect(false);
+
+    // A symlink and the file it points at are one port (a /dev/serial/by-id name and its /dev/ttyACM), either way.
+    const auto dir    = cleanDir("rp-n8-rpc-identity");
+    const auto device = dir / "ttyFAKE0";
+    const auto byId   = dir / "usb-krikzz_N8-if00";
+    std::ofstream(device).put('\0');
+    std::filesystem::remove(byId);
+    std::error_code linked;
+    std::filesystem::create_symlink(device, byId, linked);
+    if (linked) return;  // no symlinks here (an unprivileged Windows): the by-name half above is what holds
+    const auto session = rpc->n8Open(byId.string());
+    REQUIRE(session.status == "ok");
+    host.setPort(device.string());
+    host.connect(true);
+    CHECK_FALSE(host.getConfig().connected);
+    CHECK(rpc->n8Close(static_cast<std::int32_t>(session.value)));
+    host.connect(true);
+    REQUIRE(host.getConfig().connected);
+    CHECK(rpc->n8Open(byId.string()).message == "cannot open serial port: " + byId.string());
+    host.connect(false);
+    // The facet unhooks itself as it goes: the host connects freely after it.
+    rpc.reset();
+    host.connect(true);
+    CHECK(host.getConfig().connected);
+    host.connect(false);
+}
+
+TEST_CASE("a listing's names reach the session as TextDecoder decoded them", "[n8-rpc]") {
+    FakeN8        dev;
+    N8Host        host(factoryFor(dev), twoPorts(), cleanDir("rp-n8-rpc-test").string());
+    rp::n8::N8Rpc rpc(host, factoryFor(dev), twoPorts());
+    // Well-formed names as they are; each maximal ill-formed subpart one U+FFFD, as the WHATWG decoder gives it.
+    const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> names = {
+        {"plain.nes", "plain.nes"},
+        {"\xC3\xA9t\xC3\xA9.sav", "\xC3\xA9t\xC3\xA9.sav"},                    // valid two-byte sequences
+        {"a\xF0\x9F\x8E\xB5", "a\xF0\x9F\x8E\xB5"},                            // a valid four-byte one
+        {"b\xFF", "b\xEF\xBF\xBD"},                                            // a byte that never leads
+        {"c\xC0\xAF", "c\xEF\xBF\xBD\xEF\xBF\xBD"},                            // an overlong lead, then a stray
+        {"d\xE2\x82", "d\xEF\xBF\xBD"},                                        // a sequence cut short
+        {"e\xED\xA0\x80", "e\xEF\xBF\xBD\xEF\xBF\xBD\xEF\xBF\xBD"},            // a surrogate's encoding
+        {"f\xE2\x82x", "f\xEF\xBF\xBDx"},                                      // cut short by an ASCII byte
+    };
+    for (const auto& [raw, decoded] : names) dev.files["d/" + raw] = {1};
+    const rp::n8::N8Reply opened = rpc.n8Open("/dev/ttyACM0");
+    const auto            h      = static_cast<std::int32_t>(opened.value);
+    const rp::n8::N8Reply listed = rpc.n8ListDir(h, "d");
+    REQUIRE(listed.status == "ok");
+    std::vector<std::string> got;
+    for (const auto& e : listed.entries) got.push_back(e.name);
+    std::vector<std::string> want;
+    for (const auto& [raw, decoded] : dev.files) want.push_back(raw);
+    for (auto& w : want) {
+        w = w.substr(2);
+        for (const auto& [raw, decoded] : names)
+            if (w == raw) w = decoded;
+    }
+    CHECK(got == want);  // in the card's order (FakeN8's files map)
+}
+
+namespace {
+// A port that takes every write and fails every read in the port itself, as deps/serial throwing on a gone device does
+// through SerialTransport.
+struct GonePort : retroplug::PortTransport {
+    std::size_t write(const std::uint8_t*, std::size_t size) override { return size; }
+    std::size_t read(std::uint8_t*, std::size_t, std::uint32_t) override {
+        failed_ = true;
+        return 0;
+    }
+    void        flushInput() override {}
+    std::string failure() const override { return failed_ ? "read failed: Input/output error" : ""; }
+
+private:
+    bool failed_ = false;
+};
+}  // namespace
+
+TEST_CASE("a read the port itself failed is linkDown in the port's words, not a timeout", "[n8-rpc]") {
+    FakeN8        dev;
+    N8Host        host(factoryFor(dev), twoPorts(), cleanDir("rp-n8-rpc-test").string());
+    rp::n8::N8Rpc rpc(host, [](const std::string&) -> std::unique_ptr<retroplug::PortTransport> {
+        return std::make_unique<GonePort>();
+    }, twoPorts());
+    const auto h     = static_cast<std::int32_t>(rpc.n8Open("/dev/ttyACM0").value);
+    const auto reply = rpc.n8Handshake(h, 0);
+    CHECK(reply.status == "linkDown");
+    CHECK(reply.message == "read failed: Input/output error");
+}

+// The bare-Edio ops below are each written around a throw (an op reports its failure and exits): the pack's Edio, Menu
+// and Ops behind the calls they make, each throwing a failed Status's text (failureText, the port's own words or
+// describe()'s), so an op reads as a short script.
+struct Edio : rp::n8::Edio {
+    using rp::n8::Edio::Edio;
+
+    void connect() { ok(rp::n8::Edio::connect()); }
+    void setReadTimeout(int ms) { timeouts().readMs = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(ms); }
+    void readData(std::uint8_t* out, std::size_t n) { ok(rp::n8::Edio::readData(out, n)); }
+    void memRD(std::uint32_t addr, std::uint8_t* out, std::size_t n) { ok(rp::n8::Edio::memRD(addr, out, n)); }
+    void memWR(std::uint32_t addr, const std::uint8_t* d, std::size_t n) { ok(rp::n8::Edio::memWR(addr, d, n)); }
+    void fifoWR(const std::uint8_t* d, std::size_t n) { ok(rp::n8::Edio::fifoWR(d, n)); }
+    void dirMake(const std::string& path) { ok(rp::n8::Edio::dirMake(path), path); }
+    void fileDelete(const std::string& path) { ok(rp::n8::Edio::fileDelete(path), path); }
+    std::uint64_t freeSpace() {
+        std::uint64_t bytes = 0;
+        ok(rp::n8::Edio::freeSpace(bytes));
+        return bytes;
+    }
+    std::vector<std::uint8_t> sysInfo() {
+        std::uint8_t b[SIZE_SYS_INFO];
+        ok(rp::n8::Edio::sysInfo(b));
+        return {b, b + sizeof b};
+    }
+    std::vector<std::uint8_t> vdc() {
+        std::uint8_t b[SIZE_VDC];
+        ok(rp::n8::Edio::vdc(b));
+        return {b, b + sizeof b};
+    }
+    std::vector<std::uint8_t> readFile(const std::string& path) {
+        std::vector<std::uint8_t> out;
+        const rp::n8::FileSink    sink{[](void* ctx, std::size_t size) {
+                                        auto& v = *static_cast<std::vector<std::uint8_t>*>(ctx);
+                                        v.resize(size);
+                                        return v.data();
+                                    },
+                                    &out};
+        std::size_t size = 0;
+        ok(rp::n8::readFile(*this, path, sink, &size), path);
+        out.resize(size);
+        return out;
+    }
+    void writeFile(const std::string& path, const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& data) {
+        ok(rp::n8::writeFile(*this, path, {data.data(), data.size()}), path);
+    }
+
+    void ok(const rp::n8::Status& s, std::string_view path = {}) {
+        if (!s.ok()) throw std::runtime_error(failureText(s, *this, path));
+    }
+};
````

- [ ] **Step 7: The device check runs the protocol**

`N8Protocol.{hpp,cpp}` beside the check's `DeviceCheck.cpp`: a scripted cart, a static Edio, a handshake, a `bootRom`
with a ROM and a battery, a `readFile`, a cancelled boot and every primitive and menu command the first two do not
reach (bulk replies zero-filled by the script, the screen buffers static), so section GC keeps them under the trap.
Its constants, 1390 bytes counted by hand in the header and an FNV-1a over them, are held on the desktop by a new
`[device-check]` case that allocates nothing; `main.cpp` prints a second result line and a protocol failure with the
types passing blinks 20. n8's device-mode entry joins `DeviceMode.test.cpp`'s "carries no description" loop.

Create `packages/graph-runtime/device-check/N8Protocol.hpp`:

````cpp
#pragma once

// The N8 pack's protocol in the device image (docs/modular-graph-phase-e2-design.md section 4): its Edio, Menu and Ops
// (packages/n8/native/src/n8), which the pack's node does not call, so an image that only registered the node would
// link none of them and the link trap would prove nothing about them. This check calls them, so the image links them
// under the trap, and when it runs (E3's rig) it drives them over a scripted transport standing in for the cart: a
// handshake, a ROM booted through the menu with its battery, a file read whole, every other primitive and menu command
// once (the image is linked with section GC, which drops a function nothing calls before the trap sees what it
// references, so each is called to be held), then a boot cancelled at its first stop point. retroplug-device-mode-test
// runs the same code on the desktop and holds it to the constants here.

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

namespace rp::device_check {

struct N8ProtocolResult {
    bool          ok     = false;
    const char*   failed = nullptr;  // the call that did not come to what the script says, or null
    std::size_t   written = 0;       // the bytes the calls wrote
    std::uint32_t hash    = 0;       // their FNV-1a, which the desktop's build of the same calls writes too
};

// The bytes the script's calls write, and their FNV-1a: what the desktop's Edio writes for them, the wire
// edio-golden.json holds the commands of (packages/n8/native/test), counted here by hand: the
// handshake 4; '*t' 15; the ROM 1074 (its open 26 and status 4, the write's 8, its 1024 bytes and status 4, the close
// and status 8); the battery 79 (open 39 and status 4, write 8, 16 bytes, status 4, close and status 8); the install 62
// ('*n' 15, then the path's length 15 and its 19 bytes in a 32-byte write); '*s' 15; the file read 56 (the listing's
// load 8, status 4, size 4 and range 10; open 10 and status 4; one block's command 8; close and status 8); then 85
// for the rest (sysInfo, vdc and freeSpace 4 each; dirMake and fileDelete of "chk" 9 and a status 4 each; memRD 13;
// '*v' and '*r' 15 each; a status 4): 1390.
inline constexpr std::size_t   kN8ProtocolBytes = 1390;
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kN8ProtocolHash  = 0x2FF68A57u;

N8ProtocolResult n8Protocol();

}  // namespace rp::device_check
````

Create `packages/graph-runtime/device-check/N8Protocol.cpp`:

````cpp
#include "N8Protocol.hpp"

#include <cstdint>

#include "n8/Edio.hpp"
#include "n8/Menu.hpp"
#include "n8/Ops.hpp"

namespace rp::device_check {

namespace {

// What the cart answers the script's calls, in order.
constexpr std::uint8_t kReplies[] = {
    0x00, 0xA5,                    // connect: status OK
    0x6B,                          // '*t': 'k'
    0x00, 0xA5, 0x00, 0x00, 0xA5, 0x00, 0xA5,  // the ROM: open, its one block's ack, its status, close
    0x00, 0xA5, 0x00, 0x00, 0xA5, 0x00, 0xA5,  // the battery: the same
    0x00, 0x45, 0x00,              // '*n': installed, map index 0x45
    0x00, 0xA5, 0x01, 0x00,        // readFile's listing: loaded, one record
    0x00, 0x04, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x20, 0x01, 0x00, 'f',  // "f", 4 bytes
    0x00, 0xA5,                    // its open
    0x00, 0xDE, 0xAD, 0xBE, 0xEF,  // its block: status, then the data
    0x00, 0xA5,                    // its close
    0x00, 0xA5,                    // dirMake: done
    0x00, 0xA5,                    // fileDelete: done
    0x00,                          // '*r''s ack
    0x00, 0xA5,                    // status: OK
};

// The cart, as far as the script goes: writes taken whole and hashed, reads served from kReplies.
class Script final : public n8::Transport {
public:
    std::size_t write(const std::uint8_t* data, std::size_t size) override {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) hash_ = (hash_ ^ data[i]) * 16777619u;
        written_ += size;
        return size;
    }
    std::size_t read(std::uint8_t* buffer, std::size_t size, std::uint32_t) override {
        std::size_t n = 0;
        for (; n < size && zeros_ > 0; --zeros_) buffer[n++] = 0;
        while (n < size && at_ < sizeof kReplies) buffer[n++] = kReplies[at_++];
        return n;
    }
    // The next `n` bytes read are zeros, ahead of the table: a reply whose content the script does not check (the
    // device info, the voltages, a memory read, the menu's screen), kept out of the image's flash.
    void zeros(std::size_t n) { zeros_ = n; }
    void flushInput() override {}

    void reset() {
        zeros_   = 0;
        at_      = 0;
        written_ = 0;
        hash_    = 2166136261u;
    }
    bool          drained() const { return at_ == sizeof kReplies && zeros_ == 0; }
    std::size_t   written() const { return written_; }
    std::uint32_t hash() const { return hash_; }

private:
    std::size_t   zeros_   = 0;
    std::size_t   at_      = 0;
    std::size_t   written_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t hash_    = 2166136261u;
};

bool same(const char* a, const char* b) {
    while (*a && *a == *b) ++a, ++b;
    return *a == *b;
}

// Static, as an image's long-lived objects are: the Edio's frame and name buffers are 512 bytes, which a device keeps
// off its stack.
Script   gScript;
n8::Edio gEdio(gScript);

std::uint8_t gRom[1024];
std::uint8_t gSrm[16];
std::uint8_t gVram[n8::Menu::kVramBytes];  // 2 KB: the menu's screen, off a 2 KB stack
std::uint8_t gPalette[n8::Menu::kPaletteBytes];

}  // namespace

N8ProtocolResult n8Protocol() {
    N8ProtocolResult r;
    const auto fail = [&r](const char* what) {
        r.failed = what;
        r.written = gScript.written();
        r.hash    = gScript.hash();
        return r;
    };
    gScript.reset();  // so a second run meets the script from its start
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sizeof gRom; ++i) gRom[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i * 7);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sizeof gSrm; ++i) gSrm[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(0xA0 + i);

    std::uint8_t status = 0xFF;
    if (!gEdio.connect(&status).ok() || status != 0) return fail("connect");
    std::uint16_t mapIndex = 0;
    if (!n8::bootRom(gEdio, "usb-games/check.nes", {gRom, sizeof gRom}, {gSrm, sizeof gSrm}, n8::Upload::Always,
                     &mapIndex)
             .ok() ||
        mapIndex != 0x45)
        return fail("bootRom");
    std::uint8_t file[8] = {};
    std::size_t  size    = 0;
    if (!n8::readFile(gEdio, "d/f", file, sizeof file, &size).ok() || size != 4 || file[0] != 0xDE || file[3] != 0xEF)
        return fail("readFile");
    // The primitives a boot and a file read do not reach, each called once so the image links them under the trap (it
    // is linked with section GC, which drops a function nothing calls before the trap could see what it references).
    std::uint8_t info[n8::Edio::SIZE_SYS_INFO];
    gScript.zeros(sizeof info);
    if (!gEdio.sysInfo(info).ok()) return fail("sysInfo");
    std::uint8_t vdc[n8::Edio::SIZE_VDC];
    gScript.zeros(sizeof vdc);
    if (!gEdio.vdc(vdc).ok()) return fail("vdc");
    std::uint64_t free = 1;
    gScript.zeros(8);
    if (!gEdio.freeSpace(free).ok() || free != 0) return fail("freeSpace");
    if (!gEdio.dirMake("chk").ok()) return fail("dirMake");
    if (!gEdio.fileDelete("chk").ok()) return fail("fileDelete");
    std::uint8_t cfg[n8::Edio::SIZE_CFG];
    gScript.zeros(sizeof cfg);
    if (!gEdio.memRD(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(n8::Edio::ADDR_CFG), cfg, sizeof cfg).ok()) return fail("memRD");
    n8::Menu menu(gEdio);
    gScript.zeros(sizeof gVram + sizeof gPalette);
    if (!menu.vramDump(gVram, gPalette).ok()) return fail("vramDump");
    if (!menu.reset().ok()) return fail("reset");
    if (!gEdio.status(status).ok() || status != 0) return fail("status");
    // A boot cancelled at its first stop point sends and reads nothing.
    const n8::Progress cancel{[](void*, std::uint32_t, std::uint32_t) { return false; }, nullptr};
    const n8::Status   cancelled =
        n8::bootRom(gEdio, "usb-games/check.nes", {gRom, sizeof gRom}, {}, n8::Upload::Always, nullptr, cancel);
    if (cancelled.code != n8::Code::Cancelled || cancelled.step != n8::Step::Test) return fail("cancel");
    if (!same(n8::codeName(cancelled.code), "cancelled") || !same(n8::stepName(cancelled.step), "test"))
        return fail("codeName");
    if (!gScript.drained()) return fail("replies left unread");
    char text[96];
    if (n8::describe(cancelled, text, sizeof text) == 0) return fail("describe");

    r.written = gScript.written();
    r.hash    = gScript.hash();
    if (r.written != kN8ProtocolBytes || r.hash != kN8ProtocolHash) return fail("the bytes written");
    r.ok = true;
    return r;
}

}  // namespace rp::device_check
````

- [ ] **Step 8: The TypeScript half, and the old clients deleted**

`@retroplug/n8` gains its session half: `listPorts` and `openN8`, which answers today's N8 surface (`port`, `edio`,
`menu`, `connect`, `load`, `dumpSram`, `writeSramDirect`, `writeMemDirect`, `listDir`, `readFile`, `writeFile`,
`mapConfig`, `close`) over the facet, throwing `Error` and `N8TimeoutError` with today's messages (a timeout is the
device not answering in time; a gone port is a plain `Error`); `constants.ts`; the load helpers (`load.ts`); the
decoders, unchanged but for `mapConfig`'s import and a comment. `listPorts()` on a host with no facet answers `[]`.
The CLI sessions (`n8-load`, `n8-play`, `n8-bridge` with `n8-sync`) open the cart with
`createN8Client(makeCall()).openN8(...)`; `createSerialClient` leaves `realBackend.ts`; `run-tests.mjs` sweeps
`packages/*/ts/test` (a pack test's slug is `<package dir>/<path>`, so `sniffer.test.ts` keeps its slug `n8/sniffer`,
and a duplicate slug is refused); the pack's tests import `retroplug`'s harness by relative path and are type-checked
by `retroplug`'s tsconfig, whose `include` gains `../n8/ts`. `session-client.test.ts` drives the wrapper over a fake
call, and `test-native/n8-session.test.ts` drives `n8-load` through the real facet to the test host's fake cart. The
TS clients, `src/n8/index.ts` and the two test files whose coverage moved into C++ (`edio.test.ts`, 25 cases;
`menu-load.test.ts`, 17) go.

Create `packages/n8/ts/constants.ts`:

````ts
// The Everdrive N8 Pro's device addresses, sizes and SD file-open flags, as the TS half of the pack names them: the
// twins of the constants on the native Edio (packages/n8/native/src/n8/Edio.hpp), which is where the protocol itself
// lives. A session's calls (createN8Client's openN8) take and answer these.

export const ADDR_PRG = 0x000000; // PRG-ROM PSRAM (8 MB) - live code, the same chip the CPU fetches
export const ADDR_CHR = 0x800000; // CHR-ROM PSRAM (8 MB) - live graphics, the same chip the PPU fetches
export const ADDR_SRM = 0x1000000; // cart battery RAM (a game's .srm)
export const ADDR_MENU_CHR = 0xfe0000; // menu CHR (ADDR_CHR 0x800000 + 0x7E0000); screenshot
export const N8_OS_REGION = 0x7e0000; // top of PRG/CHR (0x7E0000..0x800000) is the N8 OS/menu - never patch into it
export const ADDR_SSR = 0x1802000; // save-state sniffer: a running game's live APU/PPU/OAM write-mirror
export const ADDR_FIFO = 0x1810000; // cart FIFO (NES side reads $40F0/$40F1)
// The 16-byte FPGA mapper-config block (krikzz edn8-pro-pub fpga/base_sv/sys_cfg.sv `scfg`, decoded by
// mapConfig.ts; = everdrive.h's MapConfig struct minus its leading 32-byte cheat block, which is why the
// NES-CPU-side offsets in that header are 32 lower than the USB ones). The OS writes it when it hands a game
// over, so it describes the RUNNING cart: mapper index, PRG/CHR/SRM sizes, mirroring, and CHR-RAM-vs-ROM.
// Readable AND writable over USB (`pi_di` muxes `ce_cfg` back to the host in everdrive.sv) - HW-verified.
export const ADDR_CFG = 0x1800020;
export const SIZE_CFG = 16;
// Expansion-audio master volume = MapConfig.master_vol (scfg[3]). 0 = mute, 128 = unity, 255 = 2x. Live-only:
// it applies to the RUNNING cart and a reboot/map-load reloads the OS's stored value.
export const ADDR_EXP_VOL = ADDR_CFG + 3;
// A CHR-RAM cart's RAM is NOT at ADDR_CHR: everdrive.sv forces bit 22 of the CHR address for a chr_ram game
// ("save state engine expects chr ram to be mapped at upper 4M"), so the PPU sees the UPPER 4 MB of the CHR
// chip. That bit is applied only to the console's own fetches (`!dma.req_chr`) - the USB/DMA path passes the
// host address through verbatim, so a host read has to add this offset itself.
export const CHR_RAM_OFFSET = 0x400000;
export const SIZE_CHR_BANK = 0x2000; // 8 KB - one CHR bank / the whole PPU pattern-table window
export const SIZE_SRM_GAME = 0x10000; // 64 KB - max battery RAM a game uses

// File-open mode flags (FatFs).
export const FA_READ = 0x01;
export const FA_WRITE = 0x02;
export const FA_CREATE_ALWAYS = 0x08;
export const FS_MAKEPATH = 0x80; // create parent dirs if missing
````

Create `packages/n8/ts/test/session-client.test.ts`:

````ts
// The N8 pack's client, its session half (@retroplug/n8, packages/n8/ts/index.ts), over a fake RPC call: openN8 opens
// the port by name and every call of the N8 it answers sends the facet's method on that session's handle
// (packages/n8/native/src/n8/desktop/N8Rpc.hpp), a reply's failure throws its message (an N8TimeoutError when the N8
// did not answer, as the TS client it replaced threw), load() is the host's bootRom with its options checked here, and
// the load helpers' direct writes are a memWR and a read-back memRD. The protocol itself is held in C++
// (retroplug-n8-test), and the facet end to end in test:native (n8-session); this is the TS half alone, in the mock
// tier.
import { test, expect } from "../../../retroplug/testing/harness";
import {
  createN8Client,
  N8TimeoutError,
  ADDR_CFG,
  ADDR_PRG,
  ADDR_SRM,
  ADDR_CHR,
  N8_OS_REGION,
  SIZE_SRM_GAME,
  assertGameRegion,
  type N8Call,
} from "../index";

interface Reply {
  status: string;
  deviceStatus: number;
  message: string;
  bytes?: Uint8Array;
  value?: number;
  entries?: { name: string; size: number; isDir: boolean }[];
}
const okReply = (more: Partial<Reply> = {}): Reply => ({ status: "ok", deviceStatus: 0, message: "", ...more });

// A host that answers each method from `answers` (a reply, or a function of the call's params), recording every call.
function fakeHost(answers: Record<string, Reply | ((...params: unknown[]) => Reply)>): {
  call: N8Call;
  sent: unknown[][];
} {
  const sent: unknown[][] = [];
  const call: N8Call = (method, ...params) => {
    sent.push([method, ...params]);
    if (method === "n8Open") return okReply({ value: 7 });
    if (method === "n8Close") return true;
    const a = answers[method];
    if (a === undefined) return okReply();
    return typeof a === "function" ? a(...params) : a;
  };
  return { call, sent };
}

test("openN8 opens the port by name, and each call sends the facet's method on its handle", () => {
  const { call, sent } = fakeHost({
    n8Handshake: okReply({ value: 0 }),
    n8SysInfo: okReply({ bytes: new Uint8Array(64).fill(1) }),
    n8MemRD: okReply({ bytes: new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3]) }),
    n8FreeSpace: okReply({ value: 4096 }),
    n8ListDir: okReply({ entries: [{ name: "a.nes", size: 3, isDir: false }] }),
    n8ReadFile: okReply({ bytes: new Uint8Array([9, 8]) }),
    n8MenuInstall: okReply({ value: 12 }),
    n8MenuVramDump: okReply({ bytes: new Uint8Array(2064).map((_, i) => i & 0xff) }),
    n8ReadData: (size) => okReply({ bytes: new Uint8Array(size as number).fill(0x5a) }),
  });
  const n8 = createN8Client(call).openN8("/dev/ttyACM0");
  expect(n8.port).toBe("/dev/ttyACM0");
  expect(n8.connect()).toBe(0);
  expect(n8.edio.sysInfo().length).toBe(64);
  expect(Array.from(n8.edio.memRD(ADDR_SRM, 3))).toEqual([1, 2, 3]);
  expect(n8.edio.freeSpace()).toBe(4096);
  n8.edio.memWR(ADDR_PRG, new Uint8Array([4]));
  n8.edio.fifoWR(new Uint8Array([0x90, 0x3c, 0x7f]));
  n8.edio.fifoWR(new Uint8Array(0)); // nothing to send: no call
  expect(n8.listDir("usb-games")).toEqual([{ name: "a.nes", size: 3, isDir: false }]);
  expect(Array.from(n8.readFile("d/x"))).toEqual([9, 8]);
  n8.writeFile("d/y", new Uint8Array([5]));
  n8.edio.dirMake("d");
  n8.edio.fileDelete("d/y");
  expect(n8.edio.rx16()).toBe(0x5a5a);
  n8.menu.test();
  expect(n8.menu.appInstall("usb-games/a.nes")).toBe(12);
  n8.menu.appStart();
  const shot = n8.menu.vramDump();
  expect(shot.vram.length).toBe(2048);
  expect(shot.palette.length).toBe(16);
  expect(shot.palette[0]).toBe(2048 & 0xff);
  n8.close();
  const methods = sent.map((s) => s[0]);
  expect(methods).toEqual([
    "n8Open", "n8Handshake", "n8SysInfo", "n8MemRD", "n8FreeSpace", "n8MemWR", "n8FifoWR", "n8ListDir",
    "n8ReadFile", "n8WriteFile", "n8DirMake", "n8FileDelete", "n8ReadData", "n8MenuTest", "n8MenuInstall",
    "n8MenuStart", "n8MenuVramDump", "n8Close",
  ]);
  expect(sent[0]).toEqual(["n8Open", "/dev/ttyACM0"]);
  expect(sent[1]).toEqual(["n8Handshake", 7, 300]); // today's handshake timeout, on the session's handle
  expect(sent[3]).toEqual(["n8MemRD", 7, ADDR_SRM, 3]);
  expect(sent[12]).toEqual(["n8ReadData", 7, 2, 0]);
  for (const s of sent.slice(1)) expect(s[1]).toBe(7);
});

test("a failed call throws the reply's message, and an N8TimeoutError when the N8 did not answer", () => {
  const failing = (status: string, message: string, deviceStatus = 0): Reply => ({ status, deviceStatus, message });
  const cases: [string, Reply][] = [
    ["timeout", failing("timeout", "Edio: serial read timeout (no N8 response)")],
    ["device", failing("device", "Edio: operation error 0x04", 4)],
    ["badReply", failing("badReply", "N8 menu: unexpected test response 0x78 (is the menu running?)")],
    ["linkDown", failing("linkDown", "no open N8 session (handle 7)")],
    ["notFound", failing("notFound", "Edio: file not found on SD: d/x")],
    ["tooLarge", failing("tooLarge", "Edio: a string longer than 65535 bytes (x)")],
    ["cancelled", failing("cancelled", "Edio: cancelled before the install")],
  ];
  for (const [status, reply] of cases) {
    const n8 = createN8Client(fakeHost({ n8MenuTest: reply }).call).openN8("p");
    let thrown: unknown;
    try {
      n8.menu.test();
    } catch (e) {
      thrown = e;
    }
    expect(thrown instanceof Error).toBe(true);
    expect((thrown as Error).message).toBe(reply.message);
    expect(thrown instanceof N8TimeoutError).toBe(status === "timeout");
  }
  // The port's own refusal, as the serial client it replaced threw it.
  const refused: N8Call = (method, ...params) =>
    method === "n8Open" ? failing("linkDown", `cannot open serial port: ${params[0]}`) : okReply();
  expect(() => createN8Client(refused).openN8("/dev/ttyACM9")).toThrow("cannot open serial port: /dev/ttyACM9");
  // A host with no N8 facet at all answers no ports, whether its call answers nothing or throws "Method not found".
  expect(createN8Client(() => undefined).listPorts()).toEqual([]);
  const noFacet: N8Call = (method) => {
    throw new Error(`rpc ${method}: [-32601] Method not found`);
  };
  expect(createN8Client(noFacet).listPorts()).toEqual([]);
});

test("load boots through the host's bootRom: an upload to usb-games, or the SD path as it is", () => {
  const { call, sent } = fakeHost({ n8BootRom: okReply({ value: 69 }) });
  const n8 = createN8Client(call).openN8("p");
  const rom = new Uint8Array([0x4e, 0x45, 0x53, 0x1a]);
  const srm = new Uint8Array([1, 2]);
  expect(n8.load({ romBytes: rom, romName: "song.nes", srm })).toEqual({
    bootPath: "usb-games/song.nes",
    mapIndex: 69,
  });
  expect(sent[1]).toEqual(["n8BootRom", 7, "usb-games/song.nes", rom, srm, true]);
  expect(n8.load({ sdPath: "games/held.nes", romBytes: rom })).toEqual({ bootPath: "games/held.nes", mapIndex: 69 });
  expect(sent[2]).toEqual(["n8BootRom", 7, "games/held.nes", new Uint8Array(0), new Uint8Array(0), false]);
  // Neither a ROM nor an SD path: refused before anything is sent, in loadRom's words.
  expect(() => n8.load({})).toThrow("loadRom: pass romBytes + romName to upload, or sdPath to boot an existing SD ROM");
  expect(sent.length).toBe(3);
});

test("the direct writes are a memWR and a read-back memRD, and fail on a mismatch", () => {
  let mem = new Uint8Array(0);
  const echo = fakeHost({
    n8MemWR: (_h, _addr, data) => {
      mem = new Uint8Array(data as Uint8Array);
      return okReply();
    },
    n8MemRD: (_h, _addr, size) => okReply({ bytes: mem.slice(0, size as number) }),
  });
  const n8 = createN8Client(echo.call).openN8("p");
  const save = new Uint8Array(SIZE_SRM_GAME + 10).map((_, i) => i & 0xff);
  expect(n8.writeSramDirect(save)).toBe(SIZE_SRM_GAME); // capped at the game region
  expect(echo.sent[1]).toEqual(["n8MemWR", 7, ADDR_SRM, save.subarray(0, SIZE_SRM_GAME)]);
  expect(echo.sent[2]).toEqual(["n8MemRD", 7, ADDR_SRM, SIZE_SRM_GAME]);
  expect(n8.writeMemDirect(ADDR_CHR + 4, new Uint8Array([7, 7]))).toBe(2);
  expect(n8.writeMemDirect(ADDR_CHR, new Uint8Array(0))).toBe(0); // nothing sent
  expect(echo.sent.length).toBe(5);
  expect(Array.from(n8.dumpSram().subarray(0, 2))).toEqual([7, 7]);

  const flipped = fakeHost({
    n8MemRD: (_h, _a, size) => okReply({ bytes: new Uint8Array(size as number).fill(0xff) }),
  });
  const bad = createN8Client(flipped.call).openN8("p");
  expect(() => bad.writeSramDirect(new Uint8Array([1, 2]))).toThrow("cart SRAM verify failed (readback != save)");
  expect(() => bad.writeMemDirect(ADDR_PRG + 0x10, new Uint8Array([1]))).toThrow("device write verify failed at 0x10");
});

test("assertGameRegion allows the game region and blocks the N8 OS region", () => {
  assertGameRegion(0, 16);
  assertGameRegion(N8_OS_REGION - 16, 16);
  expect(() => assertGameRegion(N8_OS_REGION - 8, 16)).toThrow("runs into the N8 OS region");
  expect(() => assertGameRegion(-1, 1)).toThrow("non-negative integer");
  expect(() => assertGameRegion(1.5, 1)).toThrow("non-negative integer");
});
````
